[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to incorporate driftwood into upcycled home decor pieces, including collecting, cleaning, disinfecting, and preparing driftwood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended using strong, waterproof adhesives like epoxy resin, hot glue, construction adhesive, marine-grade epoxy, or polyurethane-based adhesives for attaching driftwood to mirrors or wall art.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested additional materials for securing driftwood, such as small nails, screws, wire, or metal brackets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised applying a clear coat of varnish or sealant to protect the driftwood and enhance its natural beauty.
